create_encoder: create a ConvEncoder, ResnetEncoder, or MlpEncoder from config and observation space using create_encoder
register_custom_encoder: register a custom encoder class derived from EncoderBase into the ENCODER_REGISTRY by name
create_core: create a PolicyCoreRNN with GRU or LSTM or a PolicyCoreFeedForward noop core from config
normalize_obs: normalize observation tensors in-place by subtracting mean and dividing by scale from config
create_action_parameterization: create an ActionParameterizationDefault or ActionParameterizationContinuousNonAdaptiveStddev for action distribution output
